respStmt.resp: Transcription and encoding of index card for Haddenham parish church

provenance.p: This manuscript was reassigned from Ely cathedral priory to Haddenham parish church in the Supplement to Medieval Libraries of Great Britain (1987). Compare Dorothy Owen, 'Two medieval parish books from the diocese of Ely: New College MS. 98 & Wisbech Museum MS. 1', Reading Medieval Studies xi (1985), 121-31.

provenance.orgName: Ely, Cambridgeshire, Benedictine abbey and (1109) cathedral priory of St Peter and St Etheldreda
provenance.p: The Ely attribution was accepted in the second edition of Medieval Libraries of Great Britain (1964). Later, in the Supplement (1987), the attribution was rejected in favour of Haddenham parish church.
Apparently erroneously, the Ely attribution was included in MLGB3 (2010-2015). As evidence, MLGB3 transcribed the original Medieval Libraries of Great Britain index card, as follows:

"Accounts and lists of manorial tenants at the end, concerning Ely Cathedral Priory estates, suggest the provenance. Synodal statutes preceding them are for the diocese of Ely, 1239 × 1256 with additions 1256 × 1276; see F. M. Powicke and C. R. Cheney, Councils and Synods (Oxford, 1964), II.i.515–23."
However, Dorothy Owens had challenged this interpretation of the provenance evidence in 1985, favouring Haddenham parish church (full citation above).

provenance.orgName: Oxford, Oxfordshire. New College (Collegium beate Marie Winton' in Oxonia)
provenance.p: Given to New College by William of Wykeham: ‘Liber Collegii S. Marie Wyntonie in Oxonia ex dono venerabilis in Christo patris et domini domini Willelmi de Wykeham, episcopi Wyntoniensis, et fundatoris collegii predicti’ (‘Codici praemittitur’, Coxe, Catalogus, s.n.)

recordHist.source: Neil R. Ker, ed., Medieval Libraries of Great Britain: A List of Surviving Books, Royal Historical Society Guides and Handbooks, 3 (London, 1941; 2nd edn, 1964; supplement, ed. Andrew G. Watson, 1987; digital edn, ed. Richard Sharpe and James M. W. Willoughby, 2010–15).

revisionDesc.change: Record edited (Sian Witherden, 2026) to change Ely provenance to rejected, in line with the Supplement (1987). Data history clarified.

Provenance evidence supplied for Haddenham parish church, transcribed from corresponding card in Neil R. Ker, et al., ‘Medieval Libraries of Great Britain’, card index, Oxford, 1937–2025 (held at Oxford, Bodleian Library).
